# cidaas_notification_template_groups (Data Source)

Runs **POST** `/{notifications_context_path}/graph/templategroups/` with a graph filter JSON body and returns matching template groups.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_filter` (String) JSON body for the graph filter.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Stable datasource id (random UUID).

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `default_locale` (String) Default locale.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) Template group `_id`.
- `tg_type` (String) Template group type.
